challenge.method: Follow the production for a single root with nested children and surrounding comments, and compare it to two adjacent top-level elements or a standalone external parsed entity.
challenge.results: Prolog and permissible Misc do not supply additional root elements. Two top-level elements fail the document production. The separate grammar for well-formed external parsed entities does not apply to a document as such.

limitations: The condition attaches to a well-formed XML document in the named edition. The claim concerns the document element, regardless of DTD validity.
